description: This file defines the CandidateVacancy entity class for the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It models the relationship between candidates and vacancies, including fields like status and applied date, and uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: CandidateVacancy
classes.description: Entity class representing a candidate's application to a vacancy, including application status and date, with ORM mapping annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the CandidateVacancy record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the CandidateVacancy record.

methods.name: getCandidate
methods.description: Returns the Candidate entity associated with this vacancy application.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Associates a Candidate entity with this vacancy application.

methods.name: getVacancy
methods.description: Returns the Vacancy entity associated with this application.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Associates a Vacancy entity with this application.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the candidate's application.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the current status of the candidate's application.

methods.name: getAppliedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the candidate applied for the vacancy.

methods.name: setAppliedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the candidate applied for the vacancy.
